song_lines_own_segments.note: The speech-trained model emits mostly CTC-blank on these singing/mix segments, so the forced alignment is squeezed into very few frames and is ill-conditioned: the pure PyTorch-vs-fp32 (no quantization) baseline already shows a large start MAE. This set is reported for transparency; the acceptance criterion is evaluated on the lyric-lines-x-speech-clips fallback set (>=20 real lyric lines, >=3 real clips).
